jQuery TableSorter 2.14.5

The upstream project states, in the header of jquery.tablesorter.js and in the
"Licensing" section of its README at tag v2.14.5, that TableSorter is
"Dual licensed under the MIT and GPL licenses" and points to
http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php for the MIT terms. Upstream
ships no licence file at that tag, so the MIT terms are reproduced below with
the copyright line upstream gives. Hagistack distributes TableSorter under the
MIT License; the GPL option is not used.
